scope: ASS embedded font lifecycle within experimental document owner; full library remains in scope.

operations.operation: Owned record loop and decoded installation payload
operations.behavior: Safe Rust trims using supplied CString predicates, recognizes exactly the six case-sensitive section prefixes, consumes stopping section lines, flushes on fontname markers, skips invalid encoded lengths and ignores a false ReadString fragment while flushing accumulated input. Native CString Append StringLengthN behavior is modeled by truncating each appended fragment at NUL. The existing permissive wrapping decoder owns the output bytes.

Pending font record blocks outer input/classification/record completion. Begin, read, installation acknowledgement and finish are phase checked. Immutable byte snapshots survive session or owner release. Installation result is deliberately not accepted as a branch input.

Native ReadString and IsSpace remain adapters. AddFontMemResourceEx runs after snapshot copy-out and after all registry loans end, with a live decoded byte vector. The reference ignores return/count and keeps the process-private installed font until process exit. Other LoadUUEFont callers and default native-document configuration still use the previous raw FontRecords adapter.

boundary_review.contract: Checked integer run IDs resolve a live parent document. Preflight output size, EOF bool, even raw UTF16LE length and one strict-bool predicate per unit; copy native spans before registry admission. Read mutates only while awaiting input. Snapshot copy-out holds no registry loan; inputs may overlap output. BUSY, invalid/stale handles and malformed inputs produce no output writes. No raw native object pointer is owned or retained.
Commands9/10/11 begin/acknowledge/end fonts, requiring zero value and empty text. Invalid phase cannot advance the loop.

toolchain_behavior.detail: CSimpleStringT::Append applies StringLengthN even to counted fragments; direct Windows reference comparisons validate raw NUL cases. Evidence is specific to recorded MSVC/ATL configuration.

direct_probe.method: Include actual reference/candidate STS.cpp with initialized document observer. Intercept only AddFontMemResourceEx and emit every decoded byte and call order; alternate synthetic failure/success with font-count writes. Repeat each executable twice. Compare exact document trace, file positions and all installation requests. Full renderer comparisons separately exercise real Windows font installation.

limits: Finite corpus, no whole-renderer or host closure, no default enablement.

No new non-Windows, Miri, allocation failure or allocator-reentry evidence. Encoded record counts above INT32_MAX are refused by the private boundary; native allocation/exception behavior at that size is not validated.
Native pre-Open simplicity remains unresolved; no invented default.
Default native-document runtime and other format font paths retain earlier evidence only.
The lexical unsafe inventory is not a soundness proof.
